snippet: ...the road lights are still on at Ahola. Tell your men not to mistake a quiet village for an empty one. Corporate weather reports remain optimistic.
Traffic partially recovered. A forward element requests a revised timetable after an unidentified contractor presence is reported near the border.
The line repeats a weather warning in Finnish, then drops into carrier noise. No official evacuation notice has been issued.
Aftermath reports from Ahola remain fragmented. The road is open for now, and nobody on this frequency is willing to say why.
